{{Quote|This is all ''your'' fault, Artoo! If you had ''told'' us the Rebels at Yavin hadn't fixed your ''hyper-space navi-rods'' properly--|C-3PO|<ref name="UPSWS2" />}}
'''Hyper-space navi-rods''' were a component installed in [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] that assisted in the guidance of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. During the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] the hyper-space navi-rods of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were damaged and improperly repaired, leading him to make an error in plotting the hyperspace course of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Leia Organa's Rebel scout craft|scout craft]] soon afterwards. This led to the craft exiting hyperspace in the middle of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fleet, starting the [[Battle of The Keeper's World]].
